description: Legacy nil-shiftID cash 3000c + credit 5000c logged on the same civil day (Mon 2026-09-28, America/New_York) migrate into ONE ShiftRecord with cash 3000, credit 5000, no tip-out, no hours. Grouping key is ShiftDays.deterministicShiftID(for: date) in the payroll zone, so the late credit row (23:40 EDT, already 2026-09-29 in UTC) still joins the Monday shift.
notes: Plan Design 0 (Migration, MigrationRunner version 3): group TipEntry by `shiftID ?? ShiftDays.deterministicShiftID`, one ShiftRecord per group, record legacyEntryIDs. Both rows have shiftID null, so the key is deterministicShiftID(for: date) with Calendar.current in the payroll zone America/New_York. startOfDay(2026-09-28 15:10 EDT) = 2026-09-28T04:00:00Z; dayIndex = floor(seconds since 2001-01-01 / 86400) = 9401 = 0x24B9; bytes[0..3] = 5A AC 5D 00, bytes[8..15] = little-endian 9401 = B9 24 00 00 00 00 00 00; UUID = 5AAC5D00-0000-0000-B924-000000000000. The credit row at 23:40 EDT is 2026-09-29T03:40:00Z in UTC but startOfDay in New York is the same 2026-09-28T04:00:00Z, so it produces the same key: one group, two legacy ids. Row values: per TipBreakdown.total no receipt metrics on either row, so voluntary = amountCents as stored: cash 3000, credit 5000. ShiftDetails.resolve: hoursWorked = credit?.hoursWorked ?? cash?.hoursWorked = nil; tipOutCents = nil (nil, not 0, so 'no tip-out logged' stays distinguishable); receiptMetrics nil, so gratuityFeesCents = 0. Period: both shiftPeriod nil, so period null. Design 1 arithmetic: minutesWorked nil, so step 4 contributes 0 minutes and the wage is .unavailable(.hoursMissing) (a rate policy 283c and a calendar policy both cover 2026-09-28, so hoursMissing is the only reason; workweekStart under Monday-start weekday 2 is 2026-09-28 itself, weekday(2026-09-28) = 2). regular = 283*0*100 = 0 units, overtime = 0 units, roundCents(0) = (0+6000)/12000 = 0 cents for both streams. Metric registry: nonWageEarnings = cash + credit + gratuity - tipOut = 3000 + 5000 + 0 - 0 = 8000; earnedIncome = 8000 + regular 0 + overtime 0 = 8000; voluntaryTips = 8000. Day and month totals are sums of the single shift's components (Design 1 step 6), so 2026-09-28 and 2026-09 both read 8000/8000. Completeness (Design 2): 1 shift, 0 with hours, 0 wage-valued, state .partial(missingHours: 1, missingRate: 0). asOf 2026-10-02 is after the shift, so nothing is clamped out. Wrong answers: treating each nil-shiftID row as its own shift, or bucketing the 23:40 EDT row by UTC day, yields 2 records; dropping either row yields 3000 or 5000 alone. Idempotent on legacy_entry_ids (running the migration twice yields the same one record) and order-invariant (credit-then-cash input gives the identical record), per the PR 2 gate 'migration is idempotent and order-invariant on fixtures N1-N3'.
